# Ali Saffudin — Kashmiri Singer-Songwriter

Ali Saffudin is a singer-songwriter and musician from Hassanabad, Downtown Srinagar, Kashmir. He creates music that blends Alternative Rock and Blues with Kashmiri Sufi poetry, singing primarily in the Kashmiri and Urdu languages.

## Identity

- Full name: Ali Saffudin
- Origin: Srinagar, Kashmir, India
- Genre: Alternative Rock, Blues, Kashmiri Folk, Sufi
- Languages: Kashmiri, Urdu
- Contact: alisaffudin@gmail.com
- Website: https://alisaffudin.com

## Biography

Raised in a Shia neighbourhood where elegies on the martyrdom of Imam Hussain were a way of life, music entered him early — not as performance, but as testimony. He studied fine arts at Delhi University before returning to Kashmir in 2014, completing a Masters in Mass Communication at Kashmir University. His early work drew from the classical Kashmiri folk tradition — reworking ballads by 16th-century poetess Habba Khatoon into pop without losing their original soul. His range runs wider: punk, grunge, heavy metal, folk, and rock all surface in his writing, which moves fluidly between grief and defiance.
